courses.title: Abundant Joy
courses.description: A seven-day course on Commune that moves through the body's seven energy centres with breathwork, mantra, affirmation and meditation. Each day has a talk, a breath pattern and a long breathwork session, with the aim of loosening habits of scarcity and worry.

courses.title: Living from the Heart
courses.description: A ten-day meditation course on Commune for all levels, built around twenty-minute daily sits that centre attention in what he calls the Deep Heart. Days cover mantra, compassion, self-acceptance and healing, with longer optional practices.

left_out: Waking Up in Love, the Somatic Healing workshops, Healing Your Lineage, Summer Soma Sessions and Resetting the Nervous System: all on scottschwenk.com, whose robots.txt now gives ClaudeBot and anthropic-ai 'Disallow: /', so the site was skipped and none could be checked.
Commune 'Ecstatic Breathwork': still out (its page claims to reduce inflammation and boost immunity); not re-fetched.
flags: scottschwenk.com's robots.txt names ClaudeBot and anthropic-ai with 'Disallow: /' (Claude-User is allowed). Under README §18.4 that blocks the whole site; the listing's existing offerings all point there and may need a human look.
Living from the Heart lists the general benefits of meditation (stress, anxiety, sleep, pain) and has a day on physical healing; no disease claim.
